column3: Ayase Route ・ Ayase's Life Counseling 2 - Summer Comiket Arc
On the day of Summer Comiket...
Ayase and I took the Rinkai Line from the Shin-Kiba station to the Kokusai-Tenjijou station.
Urgh... Crowded as always.
W-Why is it so crowded even though it isn't morning or evening?
Well, they're all going to the same place as we are.
Eh... All of them?
Yeah. Look, it'll only get worse once we get there.
Woah...
Changed your mind yet?
N-No. Not at all.
That's good then.
Haha. You know, whenever I've gone out lately, it's been with you.
Eh?
What?
No... It's nothing.
Oh?
Well...
Wouldn't Onee-san... I mean, wouldn't Manami-san get angry?
Why would she?
I mean, wouldn't it be bad if she found out that we've going out together?
Regardless, I already told Manami I'd be out with you today, Ayase.
Eh?!
She even prepared water bottles and stuff for us. She's pretty reliable at times like these.
Saying that, I pointed at the backpack I was carrying.
*sigh* Geez, you're both like that all the time.
What are you getting angry about?
Because I...
I don't really get what you're trying to say, but she did leave me with a message.
Take care and have fun out there, you two!
...Is what she said.
...Yes. We're going, Onee-san.
It seems like Ayase and Manami have formed some kind of bond while I wasn't looking.
Ah?!
O-Onii-san!
What's up?
D-Don't you "what's up" me! I-In this kind of place... I'm going to get angry.
Why?
Don't play dumb.
Y-You just... touched my butt, didn't you?
I-I didn't!
D-Don't lie. I know you did. I can't picture anyone else here being guilty...
Don't say things like that on a crowded train! Are you trying to end my life?
B-But... Ah! Y-You did it again...!
I said it wasn't me!
I'll report you if you don't stop!
N-No good. The people around us are starting to notice...
Excuse me.
Eh?!
I-It wasn't me! I'm falsely accused!
I'm truly sorry. It seems that my kid might have touched your girlfriend.
Eh?
W-what? S-So that's what happened! Aha, ahahaha...
Hmph.
O-Onii-san, please don't be mad.
It's not like I'm mad or anything.
I'm just that hard to trust. In these situations, the natural choice is to suspect me...
Now you're just being unreasonable... L-Look, I'll buy you some juice.
I'm not a kid.
Exiting the Kokusai-Tenjijou station, we were assaulted by this year's hottest weather.
The air was trembling. A certain scent of summer that threatened to burn your lungs was emanating from the hot asphalt.
W-What a terribly long queue. Are we really going to queue from all over there?
Yeah.
Are all these people here for...
Yeah.
...*sigh*
She's reacting pretty much like I did last year.
Alright, let's get moving.
Eh? But the queue is over there, isn't it?
True, but we still have to follow the proper order of things before we can queue up.
Woah... The queue is so long...
...Phew.
You okay?
Yes, I'm fine.
Seems like the heat is starting to get to her.
Here.
Ah?! W-What's that?
It's Manami's special barley tea. It's cool and tastes pretty good.
...Thank you. Geez, don't just go putting it on my neck like that.
Yeah, sorry.
...Um, you don't seem to be that bothered by all this.
It's my second time here, after all.
Did Kirino queue up like this as well?
Yeah. She was complaining about the heat and smell, all the while playing games on her handheld.
Handheld... Oh, like those over there?
Ayase was pointing at some girls playing God Eater Burst on their handhelds, like what Kirino and Kuroneko did last year...
Yeah, something like that.
I see...
Want to try it out?
Eh?
I happen to have that game with me. Want to try it?
If you do, you might get to play with Kirino some day.
Can I really?
Of course.
Okay. I'll try.
Great.
I think it's fine like this, taking it slowly and not overdoing it.
She's trying too hard.
...But that's not all bad.
